originating_goal: Build a governed correctability layer distinct from reconstructability and preserve all session-specific requirements in a canonical workstream.
claim_expiration_or_release_condition: Release after an inspected green workflow run with artifact followed by committed propagation receipts in all four destinations.
collision_boundaries: No second canonical correction semantics implementation.

Downstream repositories consume the StegCore contract after the hosted gate is green.
blocked_release_condition: A workflow run for the compensation-aware verifier becomes observable and can be inspected.
